info.title: bitbucket-mcp 1.1.0 - Model Context Protocol server for Bitbucket Cloud.
info.description: Model Context Protocol server for Bitbucket Cloud pull requests - list, read, diff, comment, review, merge and decline - with OAuth 2.0 browser login and a deliberately small, auditable dependency tree. Native AOT binaries are published to GitHub Releases; this package is the `dnx bitbucket-mcp` convenience channel.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Authenticate with Bitbucket via the OAuth browser flow.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version.
Configuration is environment variables only. The ones authentication needs:
BITBUCKET_ACCESS_TOKEN         Bearer token; highest precedence, bypasses OAuth.
BITBUCKET_EMAIL                With BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN, an Atlassian API token (Basic).
BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN
BITBUCKET_OAUTH_KEY            OAuth consumer key and secret for the browser flow.
BITBUCKET_OAUTH_SECRET
BITBUCKET_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST  Callback URL the consumer is registered with
BITBUCKET_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT    (default http://127.0.0.1:33418/callback).
BITBUCKET_MCP_TOKEN_FILE       Override the token cache location.
BITBUCKET_MCP_NO_BROWSER       Set to 1 to never launch a browser.
Run `bitbucket-mcp status` to see which of these are in effect; the README documents
the full set.
